1-hour Binance candle data shows volume surging above 700M tokens during the push to 0.000929, followed by an immediate collapse to ~49M near 0.000920.

That isolated spike signals a forced liquidation cascade.

Over-leveraged long stops swept order book bids down to 0.00091, where passive limit orders absorbed the distress selling.

Once forced market orders cleared, sell-side liquidity exhausted and volatility compressed into consolidation.

The risk: if market-wide risk-off pressures BTC lower, market makers holding this absorbed inventory may re-dump it.
